boundaries.creator: Oslo kommune
boundaries.title: Bydelsfakta – Oslos 15 bydeler
boundaries.conversion: Parsed original GeoJSON object from Oslo kommune’s JavaScript export without changing source coordinates.

hydrography.title: Kartverket N1000 Kartdata – Innsjø, Elv and ElvBekk
hydrography.creator: Kartverket
hydrography.conversion: Original unsimplified layer geometries decoded from pinned Rdata sf objects. Coordinates retain source EPSG:25833 precision. Elv polygons use filled lake styling with river=true; sourceLayer preserves actual feature type.

source.title: Bærum poststeder, union of published postcode polygons
source.creator: Posten Norge/Kartverket
source.originalSource: Posten postal code register and Kartverket/Geonorge Postnummerområder; original feature opphav metadata retained
source.method: Select original records with kommunenummer=3201. Dissolve valid published postcode area polygons by their exact poststed; exclude postal-box codes without area polygons. These are postal areas, not legal neighbourhood boundaries. No hand-drawn polygons or point buffers.

additionalLayers.boundaryMeaning: Learning region: union of retained postal areas; not the full municipality or an official district.

source.boundaryMeaning: Six actual named coastal islands. Gressholmen follows the source's single connected coastline, which includes the physically connected Gressholmen/Rambergøya/Heggholmen landmass; no arbitrary internal splits.
source.method: Preserved official OSM API full-object responses pin the top-level island, every member way, every coastline node, versions and timestamps. Assemble exact node coordinates into complete coast rings; no buffering, smoothing, simplification, manual closing segments or guessed boundaries.

source.boundaryMeaning: Named woodland regions mapped in OSM (place=woodland); not statutory Markaloven boundaries, property boundaries or a tree-cover survey.
source.method: Join exact outer/inner way-member coordinates by matching endpoints; preserve holes; no simplification, buffers or manual boundaries.

additionalLayers.learningGeneralization: Fill inland clearing/water holes; retain sourced exterior woodland outlines and clip to the selected western learning boundary.

source.method: Exact named natural=water ways and multipolygon relations. Assemble original outer member ways; subtract original inner island rings. No buffers, invented edges, simplification or shoreline smoothing. Preserve complete lake geometry; the quiz builder applies its fixed crop.
source.versionNote: Feature properties pin the top-level OSM way/relation version and edit timestamp. The preserved response checksum and Overpass base timestamp pin inline member geometry, whose individual versions are not included by out meta geom.

sentrum.method: Oslo land minus the fifteen boroughs; city-centre component

learningGeneralization.method: Retain real coasts; merge Høvikodden into Høvik; group retained eastern Bærum postal areas; fill inland holes and assign existing unallocated land to adjacent/nearest same-municipality learning regions. Nonquiz lakes and rivers are omitted; this is a generalized learning map, not a land-cover survey.
